title: SB 80 (2024 Regular Session): AN ACT relating to elections.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Section 1 (KRS 117.001(15), definition)
(quote) "Proof of identification" means a document that was issued by: (a) The United States or the Commonwealth of Kentucky, and the document contains: 1. The name of the individual to whom the document was issued; and 2. A photograph of the individual to whom the document was issued; (b) The United States Department of Defense, a branch of the uniformed services, the Merchant Marine, or the Kentucky National Guard, and the document contains:
(section) Section 1 (KRS 117.001(15)(c), deleted college paragraph)
(quote) STRUCK: A public or private college, university, or postgraduate technical or professional school located within the United States, and the document contains: 1. The name of the individual to whom the document was issued; and 2. A photograph of the individual to whom the document was issued; or (d)
(section) Section 1 (KRS 117.001(15)(d), kept paragraph, relettered)
(quote) Any city government, county government, urban-county government, charter county government, consolidated local government, or unified local government, which is located within this state, and the document contains: 1. The name of the individual to whom the document was issued; and 2. A photograph of the individual to whom the document was issued;
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Section 2 (KRS 117.228(1))
(quote) if a voter is unable to provide proof of identification as required under KRS 117.225, and as defined under KRS 117.001, a voter may cast a ballot if the individual: (a) Is eligible to vote under KRS 116.025; (b) Is entitled to vote in that precinct; and (c) In the presence of the election officer, executes a voter's affirmation, on a form prescribed and furnished by the State Board of Elections
(section) Section 2 (KRS 117.228(2)(d)-(e))
(quote) (d) Any food stamp identification card, electronic benefit transfer card, or supplemental nutrition assistance card, that is issued by this state and has the name of the voter stated
(section) Section 2 (KRS 117.228(2)(e), deleted)
(quote) STRUCK: A credit or debit card with the name of the voter stated
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Section 2 (KRS 117.228(1)(c)1, voter affirmation, reprinted)
(quote) The voter is a citizen of the United States;
(other) Section 1 (KRS 117.001): also adds definitions of 'election officer' and 'e-poll book' and excludes e-poll books from the definitions of 'voting machine' and 'voting system'; items renumbered.
(other) Section 2 (KRS 117.228): the rest of the no-photo-ID affirmation process is reprinted unchanged (eight impediments, personal-knowledge affirmation by an election officer, processing as an oath of voter affidavit).
(other) version: orig_bill (introduced, BR 334): carries slots a, b, e as above.
(other) version: bill (furthest, header 'SB 80/GA' = as passed by the Senate): the text I compared line by line, after removing page headers, is the same as the introduced text; no Senate amendment is visible. No committee substitute exists in the action log.
(other) note: Two bracketed removals: the college, university and postgraduate-school ID paragraph of 'proof of identification', and the credit-or-debit-card item (e) of the secondary-ID list. The skeleton's triage line says 'college/employee ID', but I found no employee-ID wording anywhere in the text (searched 'employ'); only the college and school paragraph is bracketed. Everything else shown is reprinted current law. This bill did not become law.

votes.motion: Senate third reading, passed [version voted: bill]
